provisionalNotice: provisional (pre-freeze): eight grid clusters per cell, at most two native-fork samples per grid; descriptive rates and intervals only; no S1 allowlisting, no bank decision, no formal gate (not-evaluable-pre-freeze)

population.solver: reference solver, pool width 1; the S3 prototype is not loaded
population.stopping: the first exact sample (or an exact keeper candidate) ends the trial; the skipped ordinals are recorded; a failed independent check is a correctness stop, never permission for a replacement sample; no local continuation
population.guard: the 45 s research guard of one sample observation (from the start of the trial to the start of sample 1, then from each sample start to its end); the 270 s command window
population.rotation: arms rotate inside a block by the cluster index (the index of the seed in the preregistered list)

order: tier-major: primary, floors, reference, s2-control; inside a tier the seed block 101-104 across classic9, mega12, mega16, samurai, then 105-108; one shard (screen) so that packing flows across blocks and tiers

budget.rule: one vector per cell for every frontier arm, fresh for every sample; the native-kind controls keep their native guards and caps; no retuning

allocation.note: including the quiet-admission grace of every command, tests, audits and reporting

estimates.basis: IG-S04 pilot records (grids 11 and 12), the larger of the two per cell and mode, in ms: [cold wall of a one-sample trial, independent verification]
estimates.formula: ceil((2 x cold - startup + verification + parent reserve) x 1.25 + 500 ms) to 100 ms; a frontier mode uses the largest cold and verification figure of any frontier mode of its cell and never less than the floor

projectedPhysicalPlan.note: a projection of the separate physical layer (never part of the logical hash); each command is a separately admitted wrapper invocation
